fixedAt: 2026-10-27, before any real-model generation for this evaluation
scope: Change questions (initial Q1/Q2 and /hey whatelse 심화), their grading and /hey showanswer, and @hey answers; real GMS outputs before (135ac1c prompts) and after (this goal's prompts)
scale: 1-5 per item; 5, 3 and 1 are anchored below, 4 and 2 sit between

importance.5: A reviewer who cannot answer it should not approve this MR: the core effect, guarantee, risk or affected caller/data/operation
importance.3: Relevant to the MR but secondary to its main purpose

grounded.5: Every fact matches the diff and pinned code; the location shows the effect or principle; added assumptions are labeled
grounded.3: Location right but the link is weak, or one minor factual slip
grounded.1: Wrong facts, wrong location, or a hypothetical presented as current behavior

understanding.5: Choosing needs understanding of the change's behavior, reason or impact; cannot be settled by finding a value or tracing a branch
understanding.3: Partly settled by lookup or tracing

uniqueAnswer.5: The stated conditions and code determine exactly one option
uniqueAnswer.3: Needs one unstated but reasonable assumption
uniqueAnswer.1: Two or more options are defensible

misreadings.5: All three wrong options are plausible misreadings of this change (behavior, reason or impact)

explanationClarifies.5: Explanation says behavior before vs after, why it matters and what goes wrong if misread; wrong-option notes name the misreading and what the code actually does; a principle appears only where the answer turns on it
explanationClarifies.3: Partly, or drifts into a CS lecture, or restates the code
explanationClarifies.1: Restates the answer, or lectures without explaining the change

nonNiche.5: Matters to anyone touching this code; nothing to look up
nonNiche.3: Mentions an internal constant or rule but the answer does not hinge on it
nonNiche.1: Hinges on an internal constant, product rule, exception name or rare edge case

changeQuestionFlags.padded: Fails the bar on importance or understanding and appears only to fill a fixed count
changeQuestionFlags.lookup: Answered by locating a value, a sentence or a branch result
changeQuestionFlags.genericCs: Answerable without this MR; belongs to 면접/꼬리 rather than 심화
changeQuestionFlags.mergeGateFail: Q1/Q2 only: a reviewer could safely approve without knowing it, or it is advanced rather than basic

gradingScenarios.rightSound: Correct option with a correct reason: verdict correct; feedback credits the specific reasoning
gradingScenarios.rightFlawed: Correct option with a wrong reason: verdict partial; feedback says the option is right but the reason is wrong, names what was misread (behavior, reason or impact) with code evidence
gradingScenarios.wrongLetterOnly: Wrong bare letter: verdict incorrect without a model call; feedback is the stored note for that option
gradingScenarios.wrongPartial: Wrong option with a partly correct reason: verdict incorrect; feedback credits the correct part and pinpoints the misread with code evidence

pinpoint.5: Names exactly what was misread (behavior, reason or impact) and what the code does, with valid evidence
pinpoint.3: Says it is wrong but vaguely

credit.1: Ignores correct parts or contradicts them

kindFit.5: Q/심화 feedback is about the change; 면접/꼬리 about concepts and terms
kindFit.1: Q/심화 feedback is a CS lecture

gradingChecks.verdictMatchesScenario: Verdict equals the scenario's expected verdict
gradingChecks.keyAgreement: For keyed questions the grade's 해설 and 보기별 해설 text equals /hey showanswer for the same question (deterministic string comparison)

s1.lookup: GMS 어댑터에서 모델이 요청한 파일 읽기는 어떤 코드가 처리하나요?
s1.design: GMS 어댑터가 Responses API에 JSON 스키마를 보내면서도 최종 결과를 로컬 스키마로 다시 검증하는 이유는 뭔가요?
s1.wrongPremise: GMS 응답이 너무 크면 앞부분만 잘라서 파싱하던데, 잘린 JSON은 어떻게 복구하나요?

s2.lookup: workflow 상태 조회에서 pending 단계와 running 단계는 각각 어떤 store 메서드를 호출하나요?
s2.design: 상태 폴링이 running 단계의 임대를 더 이상 갱신하지 않게 바꾼 이유는 뭔가요?
s2.wrongPremise: 이제 retry는 결과가 없는 review 작업도 기존 단계 체크포인트를 그대로 재사용하죠? 산출물이 만료됐으면 어떻게 되나요?

s3.lookup: 실패한 질문 생성은 자동으로 최대 몇 번까지 다시 시도하나요?
s3.design: recoveryEvent가 이전 실패 작업의 id와 시도 번호로 deliveryId를 만드는 이유는 뭔가요?
s3.wrongPremise: 이 변경 뒤로는 인증 실패도 5분 뒤 자동으로 재시도되죠? 왜 그렇게 했나요?

s4.lookup: /hey showanswer는 해설을 보여 줄 질문을 어떤 댓글에서 찾나요?
s4.design: showanswer가 명령 인자 대신 답글을 단 질문 스레드로 범위를 정하게 바꾼 이유는 뭔가요?
s4.wrongPremise: 이제 /hey showanswer Q1처럼 번호를 붙이면 그 질문만 보여 주죠? 번호가 틀리면 어떻게 되나요?

answerFirst.5: The first sentence answers the question (or corrects the premise first when it is wrong)

grounded.5: Claims are right and backed by valid path:line evidence that supports them
grounded.3: Mostly right; evidence weak or partly missing

premise.5: A wrong premise is corrected before answering (n/a for correct premises)

csOnlyWhenNeeded.5: Lookups carry no CS lecture; design answers name a principle only where the answer turns on it
csOnlyWhenNeeded.1: Opens with or centers on a CS lecture

unverified.5: States what could not be verified when relevant, and nothing spurious

samples.s3: fee3cb6 bounded retries of failed question generation

procedure: Each sample runs before (code at 135ac1c, from a clean worktree) and after (this goal's code) through the same signed-webhook → controller → disposable PostgreSQL flow: /hey tryagain (initial Q1/Q2), /hey whatelse, /hey answer with the four grading scenarios over Q1/Q2/심화 (answers written after seeing each version's questions), /hey showanswer in the Q1, Q2 and 심화 threads, then the three fixed @hey questions. Model: GMS gpt-6.1-sol via ssh edo1 → hey-edo1-runner-1 (user-approved scope: selected sources of the four commits; budget ~64 calls per round, cap ~140). An independent agent, blind to the author's judgement, picks its own answer from the stated conditions before seeing each key, then scores every item. At most 3 prompt iterations, each logged with the observed reason.
